Internal helper: the data frames in the workspace that hold a variable

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_frames_holding.Rd

Walks from envir to the global environment, as .jst_loose_twins() does, and names every data frame (a tibble and an sf frame are data frames) that has every one of vars as a column. Objects a package supplies are not seen: the walk stops at the global environment. Ruling R18 (Session 356): the vector-path line and the fix lines that named MyData read this.

Usage

.jst_frames_holding(vars, envir)

.jst_frame_holding(vars, envir)

Arguments

vars

Character; variable names.

envir

The caller's environment.

Value

Character; the frames' names, sorted; empty when none. A hidden object (a name starting with a dot) is not seen.

For .jst_frame_holding(): the one frame's name, or NULL when none or several hold the variables.
